text:
Maria: Heads up — NYC offsite sleeping arrangements: curious who's planning hotel vs Airbnb vs crashing on someone's couch? Trying to coordinate so no one ends up stranded. Thoughts?
Jon: Airbnb + room swaps for me if we can find a central place. Saw a 3BR near Hudson for ~120/night per person.
Ashwin: Hostel option too — HI NYC has private rooms and is cheap, but security is meh unless you lock stuff.
Tam: Hotels are nice for guaranteed check-in + quiet. HotelTonight sometimes has decent last-minute deals. Also think about early check-in if flights arrive AM.
Kevin: quick PSA — I'm allergic to cats, so please avoid any host homes with cats 🙏
Maria: noted @Kevin. Thanks for flagging.
Ashwin: Pro tip: book refundable hotel rates as a fallback, cancel later if Airbnb works out.
Jon: offsite-bot create poll? I can do a quick reaction poll: :one: Hotel, :two: Airbnb, :three: Hostel/private room, :four: Couch/roomswap
offsite-bot: Poll created — react with :one: Hotel, :two: Airbnb, :three: Hostel/private room, :four: Couch/roomswap (24h)
Tam: :two: leaning Airbnb for group hangs and kitchen access.
Kevin: :one: hotel — I need quiet and reliable AC (snores included) 😅
Ashwin: :three: private hostel room for me if it saves money.
Maria: :four: If anyone actually has spare floor/couch space I can take it — will trade snacks and coffee.
Jon: I have a spare futon in my 1BR (no cats, small window). Can host 1 person for the week — DM me. :thumbsup:
Maria: you're a saint, Jon. DMing now. :pray:
offsite-bot: Poll results (24h): 9 votes :one: Hotel, 6 votes :two: Airbnb, 4 votes :three: Hostel/private room, 3 votes :four: Couch/roomswap
Tam: Looks like hotels won. I'll ping the travel team to reserve a small room block and share pricing. Anyone need single vs double?
Maria: Also — travel hacks from previous offsites: bring a tiny power strip, earplugs, and a luggage scale. Saved us from buying chargers and overweight fees.
Kevin: For arriving — JFK UberPool can get expensive. Consider NYC express bus to Manhattan + subway if you're light.
Ashwin: Bring a refillable bottle and a portable battery. Also T-Mobile roaming shenanigans — check data plans before you leave.
Maria: Great — I'll compile a short lodging & arrival questionnaire (early arrival / late departure / luggage / allergies) and post it in the offsite doc. Anyone want me to include a quick map of the hotel block + nearest subway stops?
Tam: Yes please. Also include recommended coffee spots that are open early.
Jon: And a note about quiet hours for roommates — saved several naps last time.
Maria: Will do. Thanks team — will update the doc tonight with links and the questionnaire.
